record.title: Validate recorder requests before creating evidence or starting children
record.intent: Make bounded lifecycle ownership independent of unchecked caller model construction.
requirements: Inspect recorder request and nested readiness validation before side effects and preserve any concrete unchecked-instance discrepancy without running a physical recorder.
Reconstruct finite bounded deadlines paths arguments and readiness values before directory creation or child launch and retain the validated immutable request for lifecycle operations.
Use sentinel no-launch controls for malformed requests and valid synthetic child controls for unchanged lifecycle behavior; keep private invalid values out of rejection diagnostics.
acceptance: Malformed recorder requests cannot create artifacts or launch children and valid host-only lifecycle controls retain their behavior.
